title: Frankie Valentino's "LEVITATE ME" Takes Hip-Hop to New Heights
htmlContent:
Frankie Valentino's latest single, "LEVITATE ME," is a powerful hip-hop anthem that showcases her unique style and sound. The Toronto-born rapper, designer, and icon have quickly become a rising star in the music industry thanks to her raw rhymes, jaw-dropping vocals, and insane energy.

"LEVITATE ME" was released in the summer of 2022, and it has already caught the attention of fans and industry insiders alike. The track is a testament to Frankie's talent and versatility as an artist, with its hard-hitting beats and powerful lyrics. The music video, released with the single, adds another layer of creativity to the project, showcasing Frankie's fashion-forward sensibilities and fearless approach to music.

With the release of "LEVITATE ME'' and the highly anticipated second single, "CASH ONLY," Frankie Valentino is poised to take the hip-hop world by storm. Supported by Tik Tok #WomenInHipHop campaign and a full rollout ad and placement strategy, Frankie will continue blazing her trail and making her mark as a true pop icon.
